name: theMarketer
description:
TheMarketer is an all-in-one marketing automation platform for online stores, covering email, SMS, mobile push, loyalty, referrals and reviews. This connector gives Claude direct access to your TheMarketer account, so you can launch campaigns and inspect performance in conversation instead of moving between dashboards.

What you can do:

Campaigns: create email and SMS campaigns, list them, and review results for the latest send.
Transactional messaging: send single or bulk transactional emails and SMS, check SMS credit, and manage or validate sending domains.
Audience: add subscribers by email or phone, import in bulk, update tags, check subscription status, and remove or anonymize contacts on request.
Reporting: pull campaign, audience and eCommerce reports, subscriber growth, delivery logs, costs, and real-time visitors.
Store data: upsert products, sync categories and brands, update product and order feeds, save orders, and update order statuses.
Retention: manage loyalty points, generate referral links, save and list coupons, and read product and merchant reviews.
Automations: send custom events and check which contacts entered an automation.

Typical requests: "How did last week's newsletter perform?", "Add these 200 contacts and tag them Black Friday", "Send the order confirmation for this order", "How many visitors are on the site right now?", "Sync the updated product catalog".

Requires a TheMarketer account. All actions run against your own store data.

_published_faq.name: How do I add theMarketer to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add theMarketer to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.themarketer.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the theMarketer MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: theMarketer lists 47 MCP tools, including add_merchant_review, add_subscriber, add_subscriber_by_phone, add_subscribers_bulk, anonymize_subscriber, check_sms_credit, create_campaign, create_review, delete_subscriber, get_audience_report, get_available_coupons, and get_campaign_email_report.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to theMarketer?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to theMarketer in sales-and-marketing on the Manufact MCP catalog include Griddo AX Docs, Rocket Sloth, Affonso.io, Datacircle, and Tolt.
theMarketer requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
theMarketer is developed by theMarketer. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
